subject: CAIQ provenance & ingestion checklist for Aurion CSA review
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@aurionhealth.com>
To: elliot.price@redwood.com
Cc: security@aurionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ provenance needs + timeline for upcoming CSA review

Hi Elliot,

We're starting our CSA assessment for the Q1 audit window and the audit team has asked for CAIQ control provenance tracing — specifically: a control-to-artifact mapping, brief provenance notes for runtime telemetry (how/where logs are generated and retained), and a recommended ingestion checklist for our intake pipeline.

Can Redwood provide:
- A single-sheet control index (control id -> responsible owner at Redwood)
- Short provenance notes (1-3 lines each) for the top 25 controls we scoped
- A simple ingestion checklist (file formats, naming conventions, preferred metadata fields) so our portal ingestion team can accept uploads without back-and-forth

We're under a tight timeline: auditors expect the first bundle by 2026-01-20. Is that feasible?

If helpful we can set a 30-min sync; otherwise a short email package + attachments works.

Thanks,
Liam Carter
Lead Security Program Manager
Aurion Health
security@aurionhealth.com

--
Attachment: audit-request-aurion-2026.pdf (stub, 120KB)

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@aurionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ provenance needs + timeline for upcoming CSA review

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and the clear ask. We can absolutely do this.

Quick plan:
1) We'll produce a compact control index (CSV) mapping CAIQ IDs -> Redwood control owner + short provenance notes.
2) We'll include a 1-page ingestion checklist (CSV/ZIP preferred) with naming conventions and required metadata columns.
3) For runtime telemetry we will extract short provenance lines (where the logs are generated: runtime, aggregator, retention period, and sample path/retention snapshot).

Deliverable target: initial package by 2026-01-16 EOD PT, final bundle by 2026-01-19 after a quick internal QA pass. If you need the bundle earlier we can escalate.

I've looped in Marissa (evidence coordination) and Jonas (telemetry/control mapping) to own the artifacts and ingestion checklist. Marissa — can you lead the control-index + ingestion checklist? Jonas — can you draft the telemetry provenance notes?

I attached a draft checklist and a blank control index template to speed intake.

Best,
Elliot Price
Principal, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: caiq-provenance-checklist-v0.1.pdf (stub), redwood-control-index-2026-01.csv (template)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ provenance needs + timeline for upcoming CSA review

Forwarding Liam's request and Elliot's plan to capture action items for control owners.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Marissa: populate redwood-control-index-2026-01.csv with CAIQ control id, high-level mapping, artifact examples, and upload-ready filenames. ETA 2026-01-15 noon PT.
- Jonas: generate telemetry provenance notes for scoped controls (runtime source, aggregator, retention), include one sample log path per control. ETA 2026-01-14 EOD PT.
- Marissa: assemble ingestion package (CSV + metadata README + one example artifact per control) and run quick QA. ETA 2026-01-16 EOD PT.

Notes: keep filenames in lowercase, use the convention {account}_{control}_{artifact}_{date}. For metadata we require: control_id, artifact_type, generated_by, retention_days, storage_path, sha256. See attached "ingest-owner-table.xlsx" for owner assignment skeleton.

I'll post the package to the shared intake folder and share the upload link to Liam when ready. If anyone hits blocker on sample artifacts (access/scoping), escalate to Elliot immediately.

Thanks — M.

--
Attachment: ingest-owner-table.xlsx (stub)
